policy_context.execution_authorization_reference: Current explicit owner instruction 2026-10-22 authorizes bounded exploratory M4 measurements and remeasurement after material instrumentation changes, using fresh operation IDs and full containment; no retry after a gate failure and no hard-gate bypass.
policy_context.resource_basis: One distinct contained profile using the research-only cppjieba DictTrie cache-eviction overlay at the exact repository-relative binary path. First run the same 1,024-seed/four-arm workload under unchanged hard/soft caps, then initialize two distinct dictionary versions in one process and record per-version PSS/RSS before and after release. Compare retained/live-entry evidence against the prior uncapped one-entry cache implementation and same-workload baseline descriptively; this is not an isolated benchmark, causal attribution, latency comparison, or capacity claim. The source-level regression separately checks same-key coalescing, concurrent analyzer lifecycle, generation release, and reopening an older version. One fresh operation only; any preflight/runtime/containment failure consumes it and is not retried.
policy_context.risk_acceptance_reference: Each four-arm exploratory operation is descriptive only; shared-host pressure, one round per arm and test-scale workloads prohibit causal, qualification or architecture-win claims. ApplyBatch and Upsert call latencies have different units and must not be compared as equivalent tail samples.
